verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS platform that ships a CLI and MCP servers, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out in the Ramp product, CLI, or MCP. The AI-usage ingestion API covers customers sending their own AI spend data into Ramp, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.
